subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should the remaining Slack table work ship through this new cross-channel public plugin SDK table contract, or remain a narrower Slack-owned capability?
rationale: Maintainer discussion supports completing user-visible Slack tables but does not establish approval for a permanent cross-channel SDK type and capability expansion.

options.title: Approve the portable table contract
options.body: Keep the typed cross-channel API, repair the slash fallback defect, and require compatibility coverage plus live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep tables Slack-owned
options.body: Use the shipped Slack table foundation to finish native rendering without adding the new portable SDK block type.

options.title: Defer the API expansion
options.body: Pause this PR while the canonical issue remains open for an explicitly approved presentation API direction.

recommendation.title: Approve the portable table contract
recommendation.body: Keep the typed cross-channel API, repair the slash fallback defect, and require compatibility coverage plus live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the shipped table foundation and provided the clearest maintainer-associated scope decisions on the canonical issue.
